text: NFL Week 11 grades: Cowboys earn A for destroying Raiders on Monday night; Josh Allen leads Bills to A- Here are the grades for every team who played in Week 11 By John Breech Nov 17, 2025 at 11:58 pm ET • 20 min read Getty Images Welcome to the Week 11 grades!

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Dallas Cowboys have had one of the worst defenses in the NFL this season, but the reinforcements have finally arrived, and it showed on Monday night.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With Quinnen Williams on the field for the first time since being traded to Dallas, the Cowboys defense dominated in a 33-16 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Not only did Williams play, but so did Logan Wilson , who was shipped from Cincinnati to Dallas just before the Nov. 4 trade deadline.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Cowboys had a bye last week, so both guys had to wait nearly two weeks before making their Dallas debut.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Cowboys also had two defensive players make their 2025 season debut in DeMarvion Overshown and Shavon Revel Jr. Overshown hadn't played since last December when he tore both his ACL and MCL.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: As for Revel, the 2025 third-round pick had been making his way back from a torn ACL that he suffered during his final year in college.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: As if that's not enough, the Cowboys also saw the return of safeties Malik Hooker and Donovan Wilson .

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Hooker had been sidelined by a toe injury since Week 4 while Wilson had been out since Week 7 due to an elbow injury.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With the Cowboys defense finally healthy, the unit came out and dominated.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With that in mind, let's get to the grades, starting with the Cowboys big win.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Dallas 33-16 over Las Vegas A Cowboys

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Cowboys looked totally rejuvenated coming out of their Week 10 bye.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: They dominated the Raiders in all three phases of the game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Dak Prescott had the offense looking unstoppable: The Cowboys quarterback threw for 268 yards and four touchdown, with most of that going to George Pickens (144 yards and a touchdown) and CeeDee Lamb (66 yards and a touchdown).

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Cowboys revamped defense made a strong statement by holding the Raiders to just 27 yards on the ground, which was quite the performance for a team that ranked in the bottom five of the NFL at stopping the run heading into Week 11.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: In his first game with the Cowboys, Quinnen Williams had more sacks (1.5) than he did in eight games with the Jets this year (1.0).

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The defense easily had its best game of the season, but it did come against the Raiders.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With the Eagles and Chiefs on deck in the next two weeks, we'll soon find out if the defense has actually turned the corner.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: If it has, the Cowboys (4-5-1) could be a dark horse playoff contender.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: D-

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Raiders The Raiders are a mess.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The offense has no identity and the defense can't stop anyone.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: There are holes all over the roster, and the Cowboys seemed to exploit every single one of them.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Geno Smith threw for 238 yards, but he rarely had time to throw because the Cowboys defense kept plowing through his offensive line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Ashton Jeanty was a non-factor on the ground with an abysmal seven yards on six carries.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And the defense surrendered at least 30 points for the third time in four games.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: This is another lost season for the Raiders (2-8).

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Philadelphia 16-9 over Detroit C-

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Lions

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Sometimes when you gamble, you go home broke and that's what happened to the Lions on Sunday night.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Dan Campbell is one of the most aggressive coaches in the NFL and that aggressiveness backfired with the Lions getting stopped cold on five fourth-down attempts, including a fake punt.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Lions offense struggled because the Eagles were able to rattle Jared Goff .

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: He got hit multiple times on an erratic night where he completed just 37.8% of his passes, which is the lowest completion rate of his career.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Detroit's biggest plays came on short dump-offs from Goff to Jahmyr Gibbs .

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: If the Lions (6-4) continue to play like this against defenses that can put pressure on Goff, their season is going to end with another short playoff trip and that's if they even make the playoffs.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Right now, they're on the outside looking in.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: B+ Eagles Howie Roseman might have made the trade of the year by bringing in Jaelan Phillips .

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Eagles new linebacker was a force last week and he was even better against the Lions.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With Phillips in the lineup, the Eagles bullied the the Detroit offensive line for four straight quarters.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Although Jared Goff was only sacked twice, that definitely doesn't tell the full story: He was hit multiple times and under pressure nearly every time he dropped back to pass.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Eagles offense is still trying to figure things out, but with the defense playing like this, they now have time to do it.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A.J. Brown , who was complaining about his role in the offense last week, probably won't complain as much this week after catching seven passes for 49 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Eagles always seem to win ugly, but they now have victories over some of the best teams in the NFC (Lions, Rams , Packers , Buccaneers ) and there's nothing ugly about that.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With the defense getting better every week, the Eagles (8-2) are a legitimate threat to repeat.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Buffalo 44-32 over Tampa Bay C+ Buccaneers The Buccaneers actually played pretty well, but they just ran into a buzz saw.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Sean Tucker , who has never rushed for more than 56 yards in a game, helped keep the offense on track by rushing for 106 yards and two touchdowns.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Baker Mayfield made some jaw-dropping plays, but he had some trouble against the Bills defense in the second half, throwing for just 78 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And then there was the Bucs defense, which had no idea how to stop Josh Allen .

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: At 6-4, the Bucs are still on top of the NFC South, but the race has suddenly got a lot tighter with the Panthers just a half game behind.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A- Bills Josh Allen might have just forced himself back into the MVP conversation.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Bills QB put on his Superman cape and willed Buffalo to a win with a SIX TOUCHDOWN performance that saw him run for three scores and pass for three scores.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: This marked just the second time in the Super Bowl era that a QB has scored three rushing touchdowns and three passing touchdowns in a game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: (Allen has the only other performance, and that came in 2024 against the Rams.)

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: When Allen is playing like this, the Bills (7-3) are pretty much impossible to beat.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Denver 22-19 over Kansas City C Chiefs Whenever the Chiefs need a win, they always seem to find a way to get it, but they finally ran out of magic.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: For one, the defense had problems against Denver, especially during a second half where the Broncos scored on four of their five possessions.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Usually, Patrick Mahomes makes up for any defensive shortcomings, but the Broncos were ready for everything he threw at them.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Chiefs offense had two chances to put this game away in the fourth quarter, but went three-and-out on its final two possessions while totaling just 2 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The ugliest part for the Chiefs is that they're now 0-5 on the year in one-score games.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: These are games the Chiefs would find a way to win the past, but this year, they keep coming up short.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Chiefs (5-5) can still make the playoffs, but it feels like their nine-year reign atop the AFC West is over.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: B+ Broncos In Denver's biggest game of the year, Bo Nix showed up and he showed out.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Broncos QB, who has been plagued by inconsistency this season, outdueled Patrick Mahomes in the win.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Nix took over during a second half where he threw for 215 of his 295 yards, including 62 that came on Denver's final drive that set up Wil Lutz's game-winning field goal.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Nix proved he can perform with the spotlight on him, which should help the Broncos going forward.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Also, Denver's defense continues to look like the best one in the NFL:

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The unit sacked Patrick Mahomes three times and rarely let him create any of the patented magic that he's known for.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Broncos (9-2) didn't officially win the AFC West on Sunday, but it feels like this was a knockout punch for the Chiefs.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: If the Broncos just go 3-3 over their final six games, the Chiefs would have to go 7-0 to catch them.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: L.A. Rams 21-19 over Seattle C Seahawks

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: If there's one team that Sam Darnold would probably prefer to never see again, it's the Rams.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: After going 0-2 against them last year, Darnold lost another one and it's all because the Rams had him seeing ghosts.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Seahawks QB threw four interceptions, but Seattle still managed to keep this close thanks to a defense that gave an 'A+' performance.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The unit shut down Matthew Stafford while holding Davante Adams to just one reception.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Rams got 14 points off of Darnold's four turnovers and that was the difference in the game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: This loss is going to sting, but even in defeat, the Seahawks (7-3) proved that they're definitely one of the best teams in the NFC.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: B- Rams The Rams defense is going haunt Sam Darnold's dreams.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: After sacking him 12 times in two games last year, the Rams had another huge performance with four interceptions against the Seahawks QB.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Kam Kinchens might have been the defensive MVP for L.A.:

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: He had two of the four interceptions and his two picks set the Rams up for easy touchdowns (The first interception led to a 3-yard scoring drive while the second interception led to a 25-yard TD drive).

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Basically, Kinchens made life easy for a Rams offense that struggled.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Rams also shut the Seahawks down in the red zone, allowing just one touchdown on four trips.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Those two things are why L.A. won this game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Rams (8-2) didn't dominate, but they're now atop the division and that's all that matters here.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: San Francisco 41-22 over Arizona A 49ers In Brock Purdy's first start since September, the 49ers rolled to their largest win of the season thanks to a dominant performance from their defense and special teams that helped ease Purdy back into things.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Purdy was eased into the game by Skyy Moore , who opened things up by returning a kickoff 98 yards to set up a 1-yard TD drive.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The defense forced three turnovers, including a third-quarter interception by Deommodore Lenoir that set up another short TD drive for Purdy.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Of course, Purdy also did plenty of his own: He directed three TD drives of 45 yards while throwing three TD passes.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The 49ers (7-4) are getting close to full strength and they're looking more dangerous every week.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: C- Cardinals

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Cardinals piled up 488 yards of offense, but it all went to waste because they couldn't get out of their own way.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Cardinals got called for a franchise-record 17 penalties that cost them 130 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: They turned the ball over three times with two of those turnovers coming inside of San Francisco's 30-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The special teams surrendered two kick returns longer than 40 yards, including a 98-yarder to start the game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Cardinals (3-7) seemed to shoot themselves in the foot every week and this week was no different.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The loss overshadowed a record-setting performance from Jacoby Brissett , who completed 47 passes, which is the highest single-game total in NFL history.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Baltimore 23-16 over Cleveland C Ravens With Lamar Jackson taking a beating in this game (he got sacked five times), the Ravens decided to turn to their rushing attack and that worked wonders against the Browns .

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Ravens totaled 184 yards on the ground with 126 of that coming in the second half.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Derrick Henry did the brunt of the work with 103 yards, but it was a fake tush push that won the game for Baltimore.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: On a fourth-and-1 in the fourth quarter, Mark Andrews took the snap and took it outside for a 35-yard TD run.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: It was a creative play call from a team that needed a creative play.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Defensively, Kyle Hamilton was all over the field with a sack and three tackles for a loss.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Divisional games are unpredictable, so it's hard to ding the Ravens (5-5) too much for this performance, but with the Steelers , Packers and Patriots still remaining on the schedule, they're going to have to play better if they want to continue to win.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: C Browns Shedeur Sanders had a chance to help the Browns pull off the biggest upset of the week, but he ended up being in way over his head during his NFL debut.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: After Dillon Gabriel was knocked out of the game with a concussion, Sanders played the entire second half and he led to the team to 64 yards and zero points over the final two quarters of play.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Browns defense put the team in a position to steal the game, but once again, got no help from the offense.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The loss overshadowed another All-World performance from Myles Garrett , who came away with four of Cleveland's five sacks in the loss.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Pittsburgh 34-12 over Cincinnati F Bengals For once, the Bengals can't blame their defense for the loss.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Steelers put up 34 points, but they got two touchdowns from their defense.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: One came on a Joe Flacco pick six and another one came after a Noah Fant fumble.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With the Steelers taking away Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins (they both had just three receptions), Flacco just didn't seem sure about where he should send the ball.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Although the defense was good by Bengals standards, it still wasn't great.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: There were too many missed tackles to count and they let the Steelers convert several long third downs.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: At 3-7, the season has officially reached the point where not even Joe Burrow will be able to save it, even if he returns.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A- Steelers After getting torched by Joe Flacco in Week 7, the Steelers defense redeemed itself with a dominating performance on Sunday.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With the offense struggling at times, the defense carried the Steelers.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Kyle Dugger had a 73-yard pick six and James Pierre iced the game with a 34-yard fumble return TD in the fourth quarter.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Steelers' offensive performance won't wow anyone, but Kenneth Gainwell (seven catches for 81 yards, two touchdowns) and Darnell Washington (four catches for 67 yards, ran over multiple Bengals players) both came up with multiple big plays.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Ravens are definitely lurking in the AFC North, but don't count out the Steelers just yet.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The defense seems to be getting better every week and that's exactly what this team needs if Pittsburgh is going to win the division.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Jacksonville 35-6 over L.A. Chargers F Chargers This was a total meltdown game for the Chargers.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Their offense was bad and their defense got embarrassed.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Chargers couldn't run the ball and Justin Herbert looked rattled while playing behind a banged-up offensive line that struggled to stop the Jags' pass rush.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: West Coast teams will sometimes come out flat when they have to play at 1 p.m. ET/10 a.m.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: PT, so the Chargers better hope that's what happened here or this team could be in trouble.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A+ Jaguars The Jags had been in a funk over the past few weeks with three losses in their past four games, but they ended that by making a statement against the Chargers.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Jags defense absolutely shut down Justin Herbert, who threw for just 81 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: It was a dominant defensive performance by a team that had surrendered an average of 33.3 points per game over the past three weeks.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The offense was just as good: The Jags' two-headed rushing tandem of Bhayshul Tuten and Travis Etienne both topped 70 yards on the ground.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Jakobi Meyers had his breakthrough game in Jacksonville with five catches for 65 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Jaguars made quite the statement and that statement is that everyone needs to start taking them seriously as a playoff contender.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: If the Jags do make the playoffs, they'll probably be hoping to see an AFC West team: They're 3-0 against the division, but just 3-4 against everyone else.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Chicago 19-17 over Minnesota C+ Bears This win basically epitomized the Bears ' season: No one was perfect, but everyone made a big play when they had to.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: If you need proof, just look at Chicago's special teams: In a span of four minutes in the fourth quarter, the Bears gave up a long punt return that set up a Vikings TD, and then Cairo Santos followed that up by missing a 45-yard field goal.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Those two mistakes looked like they were going to cost Chicago the game, but then Devin Duvernay redeemed the special teams with a 56-yard kickoff return to set up Santos' 48-yard game-winning field goal as time expired.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The bottom line here is that this team never panics and keeps winning games it would have never won under previous coaching staffs.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: C- Vikings When the receivers are getting visibly frustrated with the starting quarterback, that's a problem, and that's exactly what happened in this game for Minnesota.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Justin Jefferson clearly wasn't happy with J.J. McCarthy , and you can't blame him.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Vikings QB completed just 50% of his passes (16 of 32), although he did catch fire in the fourth quarter by going 6 of 8 for 76 yards while throwing a go-ahead TD with just 50 seconds left.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The problem is that the Vikings special teams blew the game by allowing a long return on the ensuing kickoff.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: If the Vikings had gotten better quarterback play, they probably win this game, but they didn't, and now they're 4-6.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Green Bay 27-20 over N.Y.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Giants B- Packers The Packers won this game, but there were definitely a few things that this team should be concerned about.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: For one, its defense had trouble slowing down a Giants offense that was down to a third-string QB ( Jameis Winston ) and a backup running back (Tyrone Tracy).

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The kicking situation is also still an issue.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Lucas Havrisik , who filled in for Brandon McManus , missed two extra points and almost cost Green Bay the game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: One thing that wasn't a concern for Green Bay was its red zone offense.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Packers scored four touchdowns on four trips inside New York's 20-yard line and that was the difference in the game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: This felt like a must-win game for a Packers (6-3-1) team that was on a two-game skid.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: B- Giants When Jameis Winston is your starting QB, it's almost always going to be a wild ride and the Giants got quite the ride here.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Winston proved that he's definitely the best third-string QB in the league with a performance that saw him throw for more than 200 yards against the Packers, but the good of Winston also comes with bad and the Giants got the bad with a fourth-quarter interception.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Defensively, the Giants did everything, except for stop the Packers on third down.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Green Bay converted 7 of 11 attempts, including an improbable third-and-10 in the fourth quarter.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Those are plays you have to make if you want to beat good teams.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Giants (2-9) are playing teams tough, but they keep finding ways to lose.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Carolina 30-27 (OT) over Atlanta B+ Panthers

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Every time it looks like Bryce Young might NOT be the QB of the future in Carolina, he goes out and wins everyone back by playing a game like this.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Young was absolutely brilliant: Not only did he throw for a franchise-record 448 yards, but 318 of that came in the second half and overtime.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Tet McMillan had a career day with 130 yards and two touchdowns on eight catches.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The most impressive part is that all of this came against a Falcons defense that had been one of the best in the NFL at stopping the pass.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: If Young can just play close to this level going forward, the Panthers (6-5) will have a serious shot of winning the NFC South.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: C Falcons With the Falcons up 21-10 in the second half, that lead should have been safe with the way Atlanta's defense has been playing this year, but the unit suffered a total collapse in the second half.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Panthers piled up 345 yards in the second half (and overtime) and every time the Falcons needed a big stop, they couldn't get it.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The offense didn't help things by disappearing in the second half.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Drake London (119 yards receiving) and Bijan Robinson (143 total yards) came up big in the first three quarters, but they combined for just 13 total yards in the fourth quarter and overtime.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Houston 16-13 over Tennessee C Texans The Texans won't be bragging to anyone about this win.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: They got shut out in the first half before finally coming alive in the third quarter with two scoring drives of more than 60 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Those were their only two drives the entire game of more than 60 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Davis Mills struggled against the Titans defense, but he came up big in the fourth quarter leading Houston on a drive that led to Matthew Wright's game-winning field goal.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With C.J. Stroud out, it's all about survival for the Texans (5-5) and that's exactly what they did here.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: For the first time this season, this team is now at .500.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: C Titans The Titans have the worst record in the NFL, but they definitely haven't given up on the season.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Tennessee's defense continues to play hard and the Texans found that out firsthand during a first half where Houston was shut out.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Titans defense played well enough to win, but the problem is that the offense can't seem to get consistently move the ball.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Cam Ward continues to show flashes, but this team just doesn't have the talent on the offensive side of the ball right now to beat good teams.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Miami 16-13 (OT) over Washington (in Madrid) B- Commanders For the first time in five weeks, the Commanders defense showed up to play and the unit almost carried Washington to a win.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Commanders absolutely shut down the Dolphins in the red zone, holding them to just one TD on five trips inside the 20-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Washington had two crucial goal line stands, including one in the final minute that forced overtime.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With Jayden Daniels out, Marcus Mariota actually played well for most of the game until throwing a back-breaking interception in overtime that set the Dolphins up for a game-winning field goal.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Commanders had a chance to win in regulation, but Matt Gay missed from 56 yards out, which was his second miss of the day.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: At this point, it might be too late to make a kicking change, but the position has certainly been a problem for Washington this year.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: This was the Commanders' best performance in over a month, but it still wasn't good enough to win the game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: At 3-8, it now feels like Washington's season is all but over.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: B Dolphins It took almost half the season, but the Dolphins seem to have found their secret to success: Give the ball to De'Von Achane .

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Dolphins running back ran for 120 yards with 40 of that coming in the fourth quarter to help set up Miami's game-tying touchdown.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The defense got gashed up at times by a Commanders rushing attack that totaled 179 yards, but the unit also made two of the biggest plays of the game: Not only was their a goal line stand in the fourth quarter that kept the Commanders from taking a 20-13 lead, but there was also an interception from Jack Jones in overtime that helped send Miami to the win.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: At 4-7, the Dolphins' season is hanging on by a thread, but it's still hanging there as they head into their Week 12 bye.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: New England 27-14 over N.Y.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Jets (Thursday) B

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Patriots Drake Maye took his MVP campaign into prime time on Thursday and he showed a national audience what makes him so good: He's accurate (He completed 73.5% of his passes), he doesn't make mistakes (He didn't turn the ball over) and he always seems to come up in the clutch (He completed 6 of 10 passes for 60 yards on third down).

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Patriots defense let the Jets hang around with New York getting two TD drives of 65 yards or more in the first three quarters, but the defense put the clamps down in the fourth quarter to clinch the win.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Patriots are now 9-2 and they're a very real threat to earn the No. 1 overall seed in the AFC.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: C Jets At this point, it's pretty clear what the Jets are: A bad team that occasionally plays spurts of good football, and that's exactly what happened on Thursday night.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The offense looked impressive on the Jets' opening TD drive that took more than eight minutes off the clock, but then it completely disappeared after that.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The defense did a solid job of shutting down the Patriots, rushing attack, but they had no answers for Drake Maye.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: This team hasn't had very many answers for anything this year, which is a big reason why it is 2-7.

text: Game Recap Presented by Game Recap: Cowboys take down rivals, 24-21 Nov 23, 2025 at 07:11 PM Kurt Daniels Editor of Dallas Cowboys Star Magazine / Dallas Cowboys Game Program Copied!

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Could we have a great team on our hands?

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Dallas Cowboys rivals from Philadelphia just might think so.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A slow start certainly made the Cowboys job a lot tougher, but the group showed the resiliency of a contender to battle back from 21-point deficit and pull out an impressive 24-21 victory over the Eagles, tying the biggest comeback in franchise history.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Who'd have thought it?

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Because, in truth, this wasn't much of a game for Cowboys fans … until it was.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Thanks to turnovers, penalties and generally poor play, Dallas fell behind by three touchdowns in the first half and generally appeared lost in this NFC East showdown.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But as the Dallas defense settled in, the offense started heating up.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: After an impressive showing last week against the lowly Las Vegas Raiders, the Cowboys defense was facing a much tougher test in this one.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And the unit struggled to slow down Jalen Hurts and company in the early going.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: They took care of business in the second half, though, as after the Eagles quarterback led his team to three touchdowns through the first 20 minutes of play, he never got cross the goal line again.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: He threw for 289 yards in the game with two rushing scores and a touchdown pass for a 99.2 rating.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Dallas basically shut down Saquon Barkley and the Eagles ground game, allowing just 63 rushing yards, although wideouts A.J. Brown and DeVonta Smith proved difficult in the aerial attack, finishing with 110 and 89 receiving yards, respectively.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Of course, that was nothing to what the Cowboys offense had going.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Dak Prescott put the team on his hefty shoulders, throwing for 354 yards with two touchdowns for a 103.2 passer rating.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Prescott's 9-yard pass to George Pickens on the team's first possession of the third quarter also allowed him to move past Tony Romo (34,183) for the most passing yards in Cowboys history (34,378).

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Pickens, by the way, was again a human highlight reel, hauling in 146 yards and a touchdown while CeeDee Lamb and tight end Jake Ferguson chipped in 75 and 60 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Overall, the Cowboys outgained Philadelphia, 473 to 339, converted 42 percent of their third-down tries and reached the end zone on three of their five trips into the red zone.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: First Quarter The Cowboys' reworked defense didn't pass its first test against the Philadelphia offense, although the visitors started with good field position.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Dallas began the game with the ball, but failed to convert on fourth-and-3 at the 50-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: On their ensuing first series, the Eagles then needed just seven plays to reach the goal line with Hurts completing six of seven passes for 47 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The last of those was a 16-yard strike to Brown to give the visitors an early lead.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Unforced errors were the issue for the Cowboys on Philadelphia's next series.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: They first appeared to get off the field when the Eagles were forced to punt from their own 24-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But despite Ryan Flournoy tipping the punt with his finger, he was called for roughing the kicker, providing Philly a new set of downs.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Then on third-and-10 at the Dallas 48-yard line, Hurts threw incomplete, but Jadeveon Clowney was called for defensive offsides, again allowing the Eagles to keep their drive going.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Given those gifts, Philadelphia was able to add another seven points, Hurts using a quarterback draw to slip 7 yards up the middle for the touchdown to up the advantage to 14-0 after the first 15 minutes of play.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Second Quarter Unfortunately, things just went from bad to worse.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Cowboys caught a break when Lamb was ruled down before fumbling, but on the very next snap, KaVontae Turpin took a handoff in the backfield and without being touched by a defender tripped and then fumbled himself.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: This time the Eagles recovered the miscue at their own 34-yard line, but despite a holding penalty promptly pushing them back to first-and-20, Philadelphia soon upped their lead to 21 points.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Thanks to the tush push, Hurts got his second score of the game, but the big blow during the series came when the quarterback threw a 41-yard bomb to Smith on a third-and-12 at his own 48.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Desperately needing a touchdown, the Cowboys found themselves with a first-and-goal at the 1-yard line after an impressive 12-yard catch and run from Ferguson.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But a false start on left tackle Tyler Guyton immediately pushed them back 5 yards, and then on the ensuing play, Prescott tried to connect with Lamb, who was streaking across the end zone.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Instead, Eagles safety Reed Blankenship dove in front of the wideout to intercept the throw, ending the threat.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Despite that dagger, the Dallas defense finally got a stop, and with their last possession of the half, the Cowboys were able to finally get on the board as well.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Turpin made up for the earlier mistake with a nice 48-yard catch with Ferguson again putting his team on the 1-yard line with a leaping 17-yard grab.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Prescott would then throw a quick out to Pickens for the score, the home side going into the break now down 21-7.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Third Quarter With the Dallas defense beginning to settle in, forcing a pair of punts to start the second half, the Cowboys offense got going on its second try of the third quarter.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But although the team got to the Philadelphia 33-yard line, Brandon Aubrey's 51-yard field goal attempt sailed wide left, no good.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But Prescott and his troops came right back with another drive into enemy territory.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: His 48-yard pass to Lamb down the right sideline did most of the damage, but they also benefited from a pass interference call that set Dallas up on the Eagles' 4-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: That left it to Prescott to find tight end Brevyn Spann-Ford in the back of the end zone to pull the Cowboys to within seven points, 21-14.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Fourth Quarter As the clocked ticked over into the final frame, the Eagles were on the move again, reaching the Dallas 38-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But Jake Elliott pushed his 56-yard field goal attempt to the right, no good, which thankfully kept it a one-score game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And immediately, Prescott found Pickens deep on the left side, the receiver making a leaping grab over two defenders for a 43-yard catch to the Eagles' 11-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Two plays later, Prescott scrambled from the 8 and dove into the end zone to tie the game, 21-21.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: However, fans were on edge when Philadelphia started marching and crossed the 50 again.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But on second-and-17 at the Dallas 38-yard line, Barkley took a short pass and turned upfield, only to have defensive end Sam Williams knock the ball loose from behind, leaving linebacker Kenneth Murray the opportunity to fall on the prize.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: While the Cowboys would be forced to punt, rookie gunner Alijah Clark then showed amazing effort in getting downfield and laying a big hit to help knock the ball loose from Philly return man Xavier Gibson.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And there was veteran long snapper Trent Sieg stepping into the spotlight and recovering the fumble at the Eagles' 8-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Surprisingly, though, Dallas couldn't get across the goal line as Prescott's passes to Lamb and Ferguson on third and fourth down fell incomplete.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But the Cowboys defense did its job once more, forcing another punt that gave the offense possession with 1:35 left in the game, which was plenty of time for Prescott.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: He hit Ferguson for 19 yards during the drive and then found Pickens on a slant over the middle for a big 24-yard gain that put Dallas on the Philadelphia 23-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A kneel down and a spiked ball then set up Aubrey for a 42-yard field goal with 3 seconds left.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And sure enough, he split the uprights to secure an unbelievable come-from-behind victory, 24-21.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The morale of the story from Sunday's 24-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys is that in the NFL, a game is never over until the clock reads all zeroes.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: An early 21-point lead evaporated for the Eagles for a variety of reasons as the team's winning streak ended at four games and the season record dropped to 8-3 with a Black Friday game looming against the Chicago Bears.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: There are lessons to be learned in this one, as Head Coach Nick Sirianni and a veteran team will no doubt absorb.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Brandon Aubrey's 42-yard field goal ended it at AT&T Stadium and the Eagles were left to wonder what could have been after an absolutely perfect start to the game gave them a 21-0 advantage.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: "We've got to do a better job of putting teams away," running back Saquon Barkley said.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: "I know how this team will respond.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: We've got a short week and we have to bounce back.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: We have Chicago and we have to get ready for them."

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But then things turned and the Eagles could just not get back the momentum.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Let's explore what happened from the defeat … 1.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Bottle this start and save it The Eagles opened up and dominated, getting a turnover on downs and driving 49 yards on seven plays and scoring on a Jalen Hurts-to-A.J. Brown 16-yard touchdown pass to take a 7-0 lead.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The defense then forced a three-and-out series from Dallas and the Eagles' offense, helped by a roughing the kicker penalty to keep the drive alive, drove 12 plays and 61 yards and scoring on a Hurts designed draw for a touchdown and a double-digit lead.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Dallas fumbled the football away on its third possession, recovered by linebacker Zack Baun.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: An awe-inspiring 41-yard completion down the right sideline to DeVonta Smith, followed by a catch and run over the middle from Smith, put the ball inside the 1-yard line, and then Hurts scored on a Tush Push and the Eagles led 21-0.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A perfect start.

text: And then ...

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The offense gained just one first down on the next five possessions, and while the defense came up with some terrific moments – a Reed Blankenship interception in the end zone and a four-down stop on a Dallas possession that started at the Philadelphia 8-yard line following a Xavier Gipson fumble on a punt return – Dallas chipped away.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: First, a Dak Prescott touchdown pass to George Pickens at the end of the first half gave Dallas life at 21-7 and then Prescott and Dallas drove 89 yards on seven plays and added another touchdown pass to Brevyn Spann-Ford late in the third quarter closed the gap to 21-14.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A three-play, 54-yard drive that Prescott ended with an 8-yard run into the end zone tied the game, 21-21, in the fourth quarter.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: 3. The Dallas passing game was too much on this Sunday

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The No. 1 passing offense in the NFL showed its strength after those early struggles and hit the Eagles down the field.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Pickens had nine catches for 184 yards on nine targets.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: CeeDee Lamb had four catches for 75 yards and had three drops.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Tight end Jake Ferguson gained 60 yards on five catches.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Dallas had three pass plays of 40-plus yards and four more plays of 20-plus yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: It didn't help that safety Reed Blankenship – who made a diving end zone interception to end a Dallas threat inside the 10-yard line – left the game with a thigh injury.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And Adoree' Jackson left with a head injury, forcing Cooper DeJean to play outside and Michael Carter to play the nickel and the Cowboys took advantage of favorable matchups.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: 4. 14 penalties, 96 yards

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: This is so uncharacteristic of the Eagles.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: On Sunday, the Eagles committed a season-high number of penalties and they hurt – an illegal formation penalty in the third quarter erased a big completion to tight Dallas Goedert and having too many men on the field cost the defense a Nakobe Dean interception.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A Fred Johnson hands-to-the-face penalty wiped out a completion to DeVonta Smith that would have given the Eagles a first down at the Dallas 12-yard line in the fourth quarter with the game tied, 21-21.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Things like that added up and, eventually, cost the Eagles the football game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A team that doesn't turn the ball over turned the ball over Philadelphia had just four giveaways in the first 10 games of the season, winning eight of those games.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Sunday, the Eagles gave it away twice.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Barkley was down on himself after the game following the first fumble of his season – he caught a Hurts pass and had the football punched out from behind inside Dallas territory.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: "They made a good play," Barkley said.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: "I've gotta be better.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: I let the team down in the moment.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Those things sting."

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Gipson caught a punt at the 1-yard line and tried to return it, but lost control of the football and Dallas had control at the 8-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Eagles did a tremendous job keeping Dallas out of the end zone, but the offense had the football backed up at its 2-yard line with 3 minutes, 38 seconds remaining in the fourth quarter with the game tied, 21-21. 6.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: On that final offensive possession, the Eagles couldn't finish a drive The Eagles moved the ball out of danger on that last drive, with Hurts throwing to Brown (8 catches, 110 yards) for 11 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Then Hurts went to Smith for 16 yards to the 29-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But the drive stalled after that.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A completion to Barkley was stopped for no gain.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: On second down, Barkley caught a Hurts pass and slipped on the turf after gaining 8 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: On third down, Hurts was sacked for a loss and Braden Mann – who had a great game, averaging 56 gross yards and 49.7 yards in net – punted.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: It was a three-phase loss You win as a team and you lose as a team.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And on this day, the special teams struggled as well.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Gipson had the error on the punt return and Jake Elliott, great all season, pushed a 56-yard field goal attempt wide.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: There were too many penalties in the return game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Bright spots?

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: There were some ...

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: This one hurts, no doubt.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But it WAS just ONE loss and the Eagles will learn from it and be better from it.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The offense got the passing game going and Brown was really a weapon.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Smith had 6 receptions and 89 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Hurts completed 27 of 39 passes for 289 yards and a touchdown and ran for a pair of scores.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But what was troublesome was the lack of consistency after the red-hot start.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: It is something the Eagles will continue to work on.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The biggest takeaway is this: The Eagles are 8-3 with plenty of season left The immediate reactions, of course, are very tough to take after a loss like that one.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But the Eagles have been here before and they know how to respond.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Chicago is an 8-3 team with a defense that takes the football away, so Friday afternoon is going to be a terrific battle at Lincoln Financial Field.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: That's the bottom line: See how the Eagles bounce back here.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: It will tell a lot about what this team is all about.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: "We have men here who want to get better and we're going to learn from this," Brown said.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: "We know how to come back from this kind of loss.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: I'm not too worried about this team."

text: GIANTS Giants collapse late again, become first team eliminated from playoffs Dan Benton Giants Wire Updated Nov. 23, 2025, 4:43 p.m. ET In a gut-wrenching 34-27 overtime defeat to the Detroit Lions at Ford Field on Sunday, the New York Giants (2-10) squandered a 10-point-plus fourth-quarter lead for the fourth time this season , extending their season of collapses.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Trailing 27-17 entering the final frame, Detroit mounted a furious rally capped by kicker Jake Bates' 59-yard field goal as regulation expired -- his career-long and a franchise record -- tying the score at 27.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: In overtime, the Lions' defense forced a Giants punt after a fourth-and-10 stop, then Jahmyr Gibbs burst 69 yards for the game-winning touchdown on the first play.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The loss, paired with Tennessee's victory, officially eliminated New York -- the NFL's first team out and their earliest playoff exit since 1976.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: This marks the Giants' fifth concession of a 59-plus-yard game-tying or winning field goal in NFL history, an unwanted record.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Final: Lions 34, Giants 27 Q1 Q2 Q3 Q4 OT Final Giants 10 10 0 7 0 27 Lions 0 17 0 10 7 34 Injury alert: TE Daniel Bellinger On the Giants' first play of overtime, quarterback Jameis Winston threw an incomplete pass to tight end Daniel Bellinger, who suffered an injury.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: He was promptly helped off the field.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Bellinger quickly returned to the game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Giants defense folds With nose tackle Dexter Lawrence curiously on the sideline to start overtime, running back Jahmyr Gibbs took it up the gut for 69 yards untouched.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: One play, one touchdown.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Lions lead for the first time on Sunday.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Lions 34, Giants 27 Giants win the OT coin toss The Giants, who sent veteran quarterback Russell Wilson out to midfield, won the overtime coin toss and opted to defer.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Lions tie it up With a chance to make a play and win the game, the Giants' defense couldn't make it happen.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: They allowed a 13-play, 53-yard drive aided by a delay of game penalty on safety Jevon Holland.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: That penalty cost the Giants as Detroit connected on a 59-yard field goal to tie the game -- a career-long kick for Jake Bates.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: It was also tied for the franchise's long.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Giants 27, Lions 27 Injury alert: CB Dru Phillips With just under 3:00 remaining, cornerback Dru Phillips suffered an injury while making a tackle along the sideline.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: He was quickly ushered off the field.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Phillips later returned to the game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Can't put it away Following Jameis Winston's interception, the Giants forced Detroit into a three-and-out, breathing life back into the team.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: However, despite a long drive and some aggressive play-calling, the Giants were unable to come away with points, as the Lions' defense stepped up and stopped them on four downs inside the 10-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Giants were for it on a fourth down instead of taking the field goal, which gave the Lions offense more options.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Collapse continues On the very first play of their offensive series following the Lions' touchdown, quarterback Jameis Winston tried to force a pass into wide receiver Wan'Dale Robinson, and it was picked off.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: 10-point fourth-quarter leads are never safe with these Giants.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Giants' defense breaks again After a huge momentum shift on Jameis Winston's receiving touchdown, Shane Bowen's defense -- in all too familiar fashion -- broke.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: It took the Lions just three plays to go 81 yards, with Jahmyr Gibbs taking a handoff to the right side and cruising for a 49-yard score.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Giants 27, Lions 24 Trickery!

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Interim head coach Mike Kafka is pulling out all the stops in Week 12, and the trickery was never more pronounced than early in the fourth quarter when the Giants ran a reverse to wide receiver Gunner Olszewski, who then tossed the ball left to quarterback Jameis Winston.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Winston magic followed, as he not only caught the pass, but then shook a defender en route to a 33-yard touchdown, capping off a nine-play, 85-yard drive.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Giants 27, Lions 17 Giants defense with a turnover Break out the turnover chest!

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With the Lions driving and another defensive collapse seemingly on tap, safety Jevon Holland lair out for an interception that went off the hands of Amon-Ra St. Brown.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: It was a momentum shift the Giants needed, and a stop even more desperately needed for the defense.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Halftime: Bowen's defense wilts After taking a 20-14 lead with just seconds remaining in the second quarter, the Giants' special teams unit and defense wilted, first allowing a long kick return to ex-Giant Kalif Raymond before capping off a five-play, 38-yard drive with a 37-yard field goal.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Giants 20, Lions 17 Giants score before halftime After Eric Gray, in his first game back, muffed a kickoff, the Giants' offense managed to recover and, once again aided by big plays from Wan'Dale Robinson, drove down the field before things stalled.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: After gaining 56 yards on six plays, the Giants were forced to settle for a 44-yard Younghoe Koo field goal.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Giants 20, Lions 14 Gibbs shows up Jahmyr Gibbs had been quiet for nearly two full quarters, but erupted on a three-play, 61-yard Lions scoring drive.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The running back broke out for a 49-yard run and then capped things off with a three-yard touchdown reception.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Giants 17, Lions 14 Rookie continues to shine It's a big day for rookie defensive lineman Darius Alexander, who appears to be coming into his own against the Lions.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: He recorded his second full sack to end another Lions drive, bringing quarterback Jared Goff down for a seven-yard loss.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Engine keeps turning The Giants' offense continued its early domination midway through the second quarter against the Lions, driving 69 yards on six plays for another score -- this one coming on a 12-yard pass from quarterback Jameis Winston to wide receiver Isaiah Hodgins.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Hodgins, who rejoined the team last week, pulled down a high throw and managed to get both feet (and one knee) in bounds.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Giants 17, Lions 7 Injury update: Flannigan-Fowles The Giants have downgraded linebacker Demetrius Flannigan-Fowles to out with a neck injury.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Lions answer Aided by a defensive pass interference on safety Dane Belton, the Lions offense punched back early in the second quarter, driving the ball 65 yards on seven plays.

text: The drive was capped off with an 11-yard touchdown tunnel screen from quarterback Jared Goff to wide receiver Amon-Ra St. Brown.

text: Giants 10, Lions 7 Injury alter: Demetrius Flannigan-Fowles Giants linebacker Demetrius Flannigan-Fowles got banged up early in the second quarter and was being looked at on the sidelines before returning.

text: After heading into the blue medical tent, he was listed as questionable to return to the game.

text: Game Recap Presented by Game Recap: Cowboys gobble up Chiefs, 31-28 Nov 27, 2025 at 07:21 PM

text: Kurt Daniels Editor of Dallas Cowboys Star Magazine / Dallas Cowboys Game Program Copied!

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With both teams currently on the outside looking in as far as the playoff picture, the Dallas Cowboys and Kansas City Chiefs came into this Thanksgiving showdown at AT&T Stadium hungry for a win.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And thankfully, it was Cowboys fans who went home happy as Dallas once again came-from-behind to earn a 31-28 victory.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: This marks the team's first three-game winning streak since a five-game stretch from Nov. 12 to Dec. 10 during the 2023 campaign.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: It also pushed the Cowboys' record above .500 for the first time this season, Dallas now sitting at 6-5-1.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: In a battle between star quarterbacks, the Cowboys' Dak Prescott went toe-to-toe with the Chiefs' Patrick Mahomes.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Prescott completed 69.2 percent of his passes for 320 yards and two touchdowns for a 100.4 passer rating.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Meanwhile, his counterpart finished with a 67.6 completion percentage for 261 yards, four touchdowns and a 129.7 mark.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: After a tough outing last Sunday, CeeDee Lamb found his form again and racked up 112 yards on seven catches and a score.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And with a 17-yard catch in the first quarter, he also became just the 15 th player in NFL history, and the first in Cowboys record books, to surpass 7,000 receiving yards in his first six seasons.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Lamb was joined by George Pickens, who kept his hot hand with six grabs for 88 yards, while on the ground, Dallas topped the 100-yard rushing mark again.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The team finished 137 yards rushing with Javonte Williams picking up 59 of those.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Defensively, the Cowboys sacked Mahomes three times, including two by Jadeveon Clowney, and had nine quarterback hits with four tackles for loss.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Corralling wideout Rashee Rice proved difficult at times, as the SMU product had 92 receiving yards and two touchdowns.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: In the end, though, it wasn't enough.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Cowboys outgained Kansas City, 457 yards to 362, and converted 56 percent of their third-down tries to the Chiefs' 38 percent.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Dallas also narrowly won the time of possession, 30:54 to 29:06 First Quarter Things couldn't have started much worse for the Cowboys as less than two minutes into the game, they found themselves down, 7-0.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Although Dallas got the ball first, on the team's third snap, Prescott got hit while trying to connect with Pickens, which provided an easy opportunity for Chiefs cornerback Jaylen Watson to pick off the pass.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Set up at the Dallas 37-yard line, Kansas City then needed only two plays of its own to cross the goal line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Mahomes threw a short screen to Rice, who then raced 27 yards untouched for the score.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But the Cowboys offense regrouped, found their form and came right back with a 12-play, 75-yard drive to tie the game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Lamb caught four passes for 44 yards during the series, three of which came on third down.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And the last of those was on third-and-10 at the Chiefs' 15-yard line when Prescott found Lamb in the back-right corner of the end zone for the home side's first touchdown.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With the day showing signs of being a barnburner, Mahomes drilled a pass into tight end Travis Kelce in the end zone on the last offensive play of the first quarter to put Kansas City back on top, 14-7.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: That capped a 12-play, 72-yard possession that saw the Chiefs run the ball nine times for 66 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: That included a 16-yard scramble on third-and-14 at the Dallas 25 that kept their drive alive.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Second Quarter After Dallas got a 49-yard field goal from Brandon Aubrey to narrow the gap early in the second frame, the Cowboys defense needed to show they could stop the Chiefs' high-powered offense.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And they did, finally, forcing a punt.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With that, Prescott and company were able to march 85 yards in eight plays to take their first lead of the day.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A 12-yard completion to Pickens on third-and-3 at the Dallas 36 was immediately followed by a 9-yard toss to Lamb and then a handoff to Malik Davis, who sped 43 yards to pay dirt to put the Cowboys in front at the half, 17-14.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: That was the longest rush of Davis' career and the longest touchdown run for Dallas since 2022.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Third Quarter

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Although the game looked headed toward a shootout early on, the defenses, particularly on the Cowboys side, took more control as the second half got underway.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: After Kansas City reached the end zone on its first two possessions, Dallas forced punts on the Chiefs' next four series.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But despite the visitors maintaining a field-position advantage, pinning the Cowboys inside their own 5-yard line on back-to-back possessions, the Dallas offense flipped the script, traveling 78 yards in seven plays to the Kansas City 18.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: There, Aubrey spit the uprights from 36 yards out to increase the Cowboys' lead to six points, 20-14.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Fourth Quarter Unfortunately, in the final minutes of the third quarter, Mahomes found his rhythm again, and by the time the fourth got underway, Kansas City had a third-and-goal at the Dallas 3-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And though they failed to reach the end zone on their first try, the Chiefs scored on fourth down when the quarterback connected with Rice for the touchdown.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But a quiet day for Pickens, who had just two catches coming into this possession, suddenly exploded as he took a short pass and spun away from one defender before racing down the right sideline and leaping another opponent for a 39-yard gain.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: After Pickens hauled in another 10-yard pass, Prescott then did a nifty job of avoiding the rush and dumping a pass off to Javonte Williams for the 2-yard touchdown.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With a successful 2-point conversion, fittingly scored by Pickens, Dallas was again on top, 28-21.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: However, with more than 11 minutes remaining, there was still plenty of game left to play.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But after the Cowboys defense forced another punt, Prescott immediately threw a 51-yard bomb to Lamb, taking his team from its own 10-yard line to the Kansas City 39.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: KaVontae Turpin then came up with a huge recovery of a Pickens fumble at the Chiefs' 8-yard line, setting up Aubrey for a chip-shot 26-yard field goal and giving the Cowboys a two-possession lead with just over five minutes on the clock.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And once the Chiefs came right back and used only 1:49 of game clock to reach the end zone, things got really interesting.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Mahomes continued to keep plays alive by eluding Dallas defenders, finding Xavier Worthy wide open down field for a 42-yard gain and then later connecting with Hollywood Brown for the touchdown, the receiver making an impressive tiptoe grab in the back of the end zone to pull to within three.

subject: Dallas Cowboys

text: Green Bay Packers at Detroit Lions Date: Nov. 27 | Time: 1 p.m. ET Location: Ford Field (Detroit, MI) TV:

text: The Lions have played more Thanksgiving games than any other team, playing 85 times since 1934.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: They last played on Thanksgiving, well, last year.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: They beat the Dolphins 30-13 in the prime-time game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: This will actually mark their third straight Thanksgiving game, as they played and beat the Lions 29-22 back in 2023.

text: Game Recap Presented by Game Recap: Dallas falls to Detroit, 44-30 Dec 04, 2025 at 10:57 PM Kurt Daniels Editor of Dallas Cowboys Star Magazine / Dallas Cowboys Game Program Copied!

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: There was a lot on the line in this Thursday night showdown between the Dallas Cowboys and Detroit Lions.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With both teams fighting for a playoff spot, the winner would find itself securely in the hunt while the loser would face an uphill battle to reach the postseason.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Unfortunately, the task just got that much tougher for the Cowboys as they fell to Lions, 44-30.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Dallas didn't do itself any favors in this one.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A pair of costly turnovers, inopportune penalties, poor tackling at times and Detroit owning the field position battle for much of the first half led to a deficit that the Cowboys just couldn't overcome.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Especially when they were adding three points at a time with field goals instead of scoring touchdowns.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Adding injury to insult, Dallas also saw CeeDee Lamb leave the game early in the third quarter due to a concussion.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A huge loss, he had earned a game-high 121 receiving yards on six catches before being sideline.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Cowboys knew coming into this matchup that stopping Detroit running back Jahmyr Gibbs was going to be the key to any success.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But while the team's defense held him to only 43 rushing yards, Gibbs scored three touchdowns and added another 77 yards receiving.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Fellow running back David Montgomery also picked up 60 yards rushing with a touchdown as well, as the Lions rushed for 109 yards overall, averaging 5 yards per carry.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Detroit quarterback Jared Goff didn't exactly put on a highlight-reel performance, but he was efficient, completing 73.5 percent of his throws for 309 yards and a 111.0 passer rating.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: He was also sacked only once.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Jameson Williams was a thorn in the defense's side all night, totaling 96 yards receiving, with Amon-Ra St. Brown adding another 92.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: On the other hand, Dak Prescott was under pressure throughout the game and was sacked five times.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: He finished with a season-high 376 yards, completing 66 percent of his passes for a 79.7 rating.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: George Pickens, who has been dynamic all season long, was mostly quiet, earning just 37 yards receiving, although with Lamb out, Ryan Flournoy posted a career-high 115 receiving yards with a touchdown.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Overall, the Cowboys narrowly out-gained the Lions, 417 yards to 408, and held the time of possession, 31:23 to 28:37.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But they failed to record a takeaway and went only one of three in the red zone in taking the loss.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: First Quarter The defenses for both teams were largely in control for the first 15 minutes of the game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Detroit opened with a drive to the Cowboys' 8-yard line, but a sack by James Houston on third-and-8 forced the Lions to settle for a 38-yard field goal.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: That was followed by Dallas responding with three points of its own, although Brandon Aubrey had a greater distance to cover.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But he did what he's been doing all season, splitting the uprights from 57-yards out.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Cowboys narrowly avoided a safety on their next series when on third down Prescott appeared to be sacked in the end zone by a swarm of Lions defenders.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Thankfully, the ball wasn't across the goal line, so upon further review, Dallas had to punt from its own end zone.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: After a 21-yard return, the Lions were set up at the Cowboys' 42, and six plays later, Gibbs went up the middle and across the goal line to give Detroit a 10-3 lead.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Second Quarter

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: As the second frame got underway, the Cowboys were on the move.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And the offense converted four third-downs along the way, the biggest a 16-yard pass to Lamb that got Dallas into enemy territory.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But the drive stalled at the Lions' 15-yard line, so after Prescott was sacked, out came Aubrey for a 42-yard field goal to narrow the deficit to four points.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With that being the 100 th field goal of Aubrey's 47-game career, he tied the NFL record for the fastest in history to reach the century mark.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Disaster struck on the Cowboys' next possession, though.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: While fighting to pick up additional yardage, tight end Jake Ferguson had the ball punched out, which Detroit recovered near midfield.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But they promptly marched backwards, thanks to a pair of penalties that found them staring at first-and-25 at their own 32.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: No matter, Goff found Jameson Williams for 25 yards, and then two plays later Montgomery powered his way off right guard and raced 35 yards for the touchdown.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Cowboys would still have time to add to their point total, and they again marched deep into the Lions' end of the field.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But with just less than a minute left in the half and a fourth-and-4 at the Detroit 37-yard line, head coach Brian Schottenheimer elected to secure the points.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: So Aubrey's field goal this time was good from 55 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: However, with 45 seconds remaining on the clock, that was enough time for Goff to get his side in field goal range.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Jake Bates' 47-yard kick was true as the clock hit zeros, giving the Lions a 20-9 advantage at the break.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Third Quarter

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: If there was any concern after the first half of play, things became significantly worse as the second half got underway.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: On the opening play of the third quarter, Prescott's pass to Pickens was broken up by cornerback Amik Robertson with the ball deflecting right into the arms of Lions linebacker Derrick Barnes.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Now sitting at the Dallas 14-yard line, Goff threw 2 yards to Williams and then found Isaac Teslaa in the back left corner of the end zone for the quick touchdown.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Of course, the Cowboys weren't going to go away quietly, and they responded with a nine-play, 65-yard drive to pay dirt.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The offense faced a fourth-and-5 at the 9-yard line and this time decided to go for it.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Prescott found Pickens at the 2, and although he fumbled, left guard Tyler Smith fell on the ball to provide a new set of downs.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Javonte Williams then did the rest, using a pair of 1-yard runs to cross the goal line, the score now 27-16.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But even that ray of light was darkened by Lamb heading to the locker room during the series, out for the rest of the game.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Still, the momentum seemed to be favoring the Cowboys at this point, especially when on Detroit's next possession, Sam Williams blocked the Lions' 52-yard field goal attempt, the third of his career.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: And the Cowboys kept chipping away.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Despite two more penalties during the possession, the team was able to reach the Detroit 45, which allowed Aubrey to add another three points, this time from 63 yards to inch the score up to 27-19.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Fourth Quarter That little run for the Cowboys was temporarily stunted when the Lions got the first points of the fourth quarter.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A 10-play, 40-yard drive got Detroit to the Dallas 28-yard line, but while the Cowboys were able to put an end to any more progress, Bates was good on a 45-yard field goal.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Regardless, Prescott and company overcame that hiccup on their next series and needed just four plays to do it.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: A blown coverage by the Lions left Flournoy wide open down the right sideline, allowing for an easy pitch and catch for a 42-yard touchdown.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With Prescott firing a dart to Ferguson in the end zone for the two-point conversion, Dallas was now suddenly just three points behind Detroit.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But the Lions kept coming, and the Cowboys were unable to get off the field.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The big blow came when Goff completed a 29-yard pass to Jameson Williams on third-and-6 at the Detroit 45 that saw another 13 yards tacked on due to a roughing the passer penalty.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: That then led to a 10-yard touchdown run by Gibbs, which increased the home side's lead to 10 points.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Playing up-tempo, Prescott went to work.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: During a 13-play, 56-yard drive, he found Flournoy twice for a combined 30 yards, Luke Schoonmaker for 12 and Pickens for completions of 8 and 7 yards.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But they again couldn't punch it in the end zone, so Aubrey tacked on three points with a 29-yard field goal.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With 3:34 left in the game, the Dallas defense desperately needed a stop.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Instead, after Detroit returned the kickoff 42 yards to the Lions 49, Goff found St. Brown on the second snap of their series for a big 37-yard gain to the Cowboys' 13-yard line.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Gibbs then took the handoff around the right end and strutted untouched to the end zone to seal the win, 44-30.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The loss dropped the Cowboys' record to 6-6-1, which means they will have to win their last four games, starting with the Minnesota Vikings on Dec. 14, and hope for some help in the form of those teams above them in the standings losing.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: TWENTYMAN:

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Week 14 observations Dec 05, 2025 at 07:00 AM Tim Twentyman Senior Writer Copied!

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Putting it in Goff's hands: Lions head coach Dan Campbell said the game plan coming in was to put the ball in quarterback Jared Goff’s hands with Dallas having the league's 30th-ranked pass defense coming in.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Detroit threw it 34 times vs. rushing 22 times.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Goff finished completing 25 of his 34 pass attempts on the night for 309 yards with one touchdown, no interceptions and a 111.0 passer rating.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Another stellar performance from Goff when the Lions needed it most in a 44-30 win.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Complementary ball:

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Linebacker Jack Campbell had a sack and near safety on Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott midway through the first quarter Thursday.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: After review, it was determined the ball was outside the goal line when Prescott was first contacted.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Dallas was forced to punt from their half-yard-line and Detroit got great field position at the Dallas 42 as a result.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Six plays later, they were in the end zone on a 1-yard touchdown run by Jahmyr Gibbs .

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Detroit would have loved the two points and the football but scoring a touchdown there was huge, taking advantage of a great defensive series.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Gibbs keeps climbing: With three touchdowns Thursday, Gibbs now has 13 touchdowns on the season and 47 for his career, which ties Barry Sanders for the most by a player in their first three seasons in the league in NFL history.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Gibbs is so dynamic in space that he reminds me of a basketball player with elite quickness who buckles knees and makes defenders reach for air.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Gibbs had 120 scrimmage yards and three touchdowns as he continues to make a case for being the most dangerous running back in football.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Offensive line play: It was a little bit of a rough start for Detroit's offensive line allowing a sack and five hits on Goff in the first quarter, but credit to those guys upfront as Goff was hit just three times the rest of the game and wasn't sacked again.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: They really settled in.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Rookie debut: Miles Frazier (6-6, 325) made his Lions debut Thursday working in at left guard along with veteran Trystan Colon.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Detroit's fifth-round pick in this year's NFL Draft, Frazier missed training camp and the start of the regular season rehabbing a knee injury.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Detroit scored their first touchdown on Frazier's first drive in.

subject: Dallas Cowboys

text: The Chargers are 10-4 after a thrilling 16-13 win over the Chiefs on Sunday.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Here's a game recap from Week 15: Turning Point The Chargers and Chiefs played another tight AFC West game that saw the Bolts rally from a double-digit deficit in the first half.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Down 13-3 late in the opening half, the Chargers put together a quick 60-yard touchdown drive in the final minute that ended with a 16-yard touchdown catch from wide receiver KeAndre Lambert-Smith, the first score of the rookie's career.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Chargers then got the ball after halftime and drove into the red zone, a sequence that was highlighted by a 27-yard connection from Justin Herbert to Oronde Gadsden.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But the drive stalled inside the red zone as the Bolts tied the game on a 23-yard field goal to tie the game at 13.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Chargers took the lead for the first time all game late in the third quarter on another Cameron Dicker field goal before the defense came up clutch.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: With the Kansas City offense in the red zone, Daiyan Henley intercepted Patrick Mahomes at the 1-yard line to turn away points and keep the Chargers in front on the scoreboard.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Bolts punted on their ensuing possession but not before taking seven-plus minutes off the clock on a drive that stalled just past midfield.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: The Chiefs began the next drive at their own 8-yard line and moved near field goal range before Derwin James called game with a last-second interception.

subject: Dallas Cowboys

subject: Dallas Cowboys

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: But Henley made one of the biggest plays of his entire career when he stuck with running back Kareem Hunt on a wheel route.

subject: Dallas Cowboys
text: Henley tracked the pass and made an over-the-shoulder catch at the 1-yard line to keep the Bolts in front.
